title: (RHBA-2016:2637) atomic-devmode bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated atomic-devmode packages that fix several bugs and add various enhancements are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic Host 7.
portal_synopsis: atomic-devmode bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Atomic Host|7|x86_64
portal_solution: This package update is part of the cumulative update for the Atomic Host. To upgrade your Atomic Host use the "atomic host upgrade" command on your system.
portal_description:
The atomic-devmode package allows users to easily try the Red Hat Atomic Cloud Image. It adds a new GRUB2 menu item labeled "Developer Mode" which allows users to boot the system without having to set up cloud-init. When in Developer Mode, a root password will automatically be generated, and users will be logged automatically into an interactive session in which Cockpit is downloaded and started.

The atomic-devmode package has been upgraded to upstream version 0.3.5, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version, most notably integration with Cockpit's new password reset support. (BZ#1374044)

Users of atomic-devmode are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which fixes these bugs and adds these enhancements.
